character_types: boss in suit and red tie
housewife played by a man in a wig
visual_synopsis: A man in a suit and red tie sits behind an office desk taking a phone call and then lectures a young woman employee who stands in front of him. At dusk he leaves in a black sedan on a wet city street, climbs to an apartment where a woman in a red coat lets him in, and inside a heavily furnished flat a blonde-wigged wife, visibly played by a male actor, harangues him while he answers back.
